comment: Golden scoring vectors. Read by BOTH the agent suite (test/tiers.test.ts) and the web suite (web/lib/core/tiers.test.ts). The agent computes a user's tier locally for the Discord card; the server computes it for the leaderboard. If those two ever disagree, a user sees one tier on their profile and another on the board. Changing the ladder means changing this file, which fails both suites until both implementations are updated together.
